# Glory Panel & Paint

> Glory Panel & Paint is a panel beating and spray painting workshop in Hornby, Christchurch, New Zealand. Rated 5.0 stars on Google from 300+ reviews. We handle all major NZ insurance claims from start to finish, offer free courtesy cars and guarantee our workmanship.

Key business details:

- Address: 13–15 Smarts Road, Hornby, Christchurch, Canterbury, New Zealand
- Phone: 03 420 2022 (+64 3 420 2022) · Mobile: 021 0880 5994 (Joey)
- Email: info@glorypanelandpaint.co.nz · Quotes: quotes@glorypanelandpaint.co.nz
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7:30am–5:00pm, Saturday 9:00am–5:00pm, Sunday closed
- Services: panel beating, spray painting, smash and chassis repairs, rust repairs and fleet work, using Spies Hecker waterborne paint
